scope: The extant sandstone Christ Church Cathedral in Fredericton, with the cruciform nave, low aisles, east sanctuary tracing, side porch, crossing belfry and tall post-fire spire.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The cathedral records the 1911 fire and construction of a replacement spire reaching 198 feet.
Parks Canada documents the Gothic Revival cruciform layout, sandstone and Caen stone, high nave, crossing tower, projecting porch, side aisles, lancets and buttresses.
The owner’s engineering report describes the long and cross gables, masonry material, and restoration after the fire.
